surface: Complete against react-oidc-context 3.3.1: AuthContext, AuthProvider, AuthState/ErrorContext, reducer, useAuth, useAutoSignin, hasAuthParams, withAuth, withAuthenticationRequired. oidc-client-ts remains a peer; its source is not vendored.
divergences: Octane has no class components, so withAuth/withAuthenticationRequired wrap function components via createElement rather than JSX class components.
Octane has no StrictMode double-invoke; AuthProvider still initializes once via didInitialize.
HOCs stay functions and render with createElement instead of JSX.
ssr: AuthProvider constructs a settings-only UserManager stub when window is undefined and leaves navigator methods throwing until a custom UserManager is supplied or the client hydrates. Initial state is isLoading true / isAuthenticated false.
